# Baret

> Baret is a security and policy layer that runs before a wallet, dApp or AI agent signs a transaction. It simulates the transaction, runs it through risk checks, applies the user's rules and returns a Safe, Caution or Blocked verdict with the reasons. For agents it adds an on-chain spending limit. Baret runs on Monad testnet today (chain id 10143); Stellar and Casper are next. Nothing is on mainnet.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what Baret checks and how the verdict reads
- [Showcase](/showcase): six demo sites on Monad testnet, each with an honest and an attack version of the same button

The demo sites live at /scrybe, /novaswap, /pixeldrop, /orbityield, /claimhub and /launchpad. They imitate real products on purpose and carry noindex. They are not real services.
